title: lazycmd project profile
description:
~/.config/lazycmd/projects/<name>.yaml: a central profile for one repo, kept outside the repo. Matched by path (the repo or any folder below a listed path) or, with no path, by the file name equalling the repo's folder name. Keep in sync with internal/config/project.go. Reference from a YAML file with:
  # yaml-language-server: $schema=../../../path/to/lazycmd-profile.schema.json

path.description: Repo this profile is for. ~ is expanded; a relative path is relative to this file.

confirm.description: Ask before running these commands in this repo, keyed by command name or id as in defaults: true for 'Run <name>?', or the question with {param} placeholders. Adds or changes a confirm; false can't remove one.

terminal.description: Commands (by name or id, as in defaults) that run with the real terminal on enter in this repo, like terminal: true in a command's own file.

include.description: Commands to add to 'This project'. Each entry is a script (its <name>.lazycmd.yaml sidecar beside it is picked up), a <name>.lazycmd.yaml sidecar (its script sits beside it, or the sidecar sets run:/script:), a commands.yaml-shaped file, or a folder of scripts. ~ is expanded; relative paths are relative to this file. The repo's own .lazycmd/ wins on a name clash.

defaults.description: Preselected values for param forms, keyed by command name ('deploy-staging', 'maven: test') or id ('global:deploy-staging'), then by param name. Applies to any command, including discovered feature commands. Values stay editable in the form. A value can refer to another param of the same command as ${name}; references resolve when the form opens, from that param's default, and chain. A list preselects options of a multi param.

params.description: This repo's choices for select and multi params, keyed by command name or id, then by param name. options replaces the param's options (and its options_cmd, if any); default sets its preselected value and is checked against the options. Works on any command, e.g. a global script's sidecar. A defaults: entry for the same param wins.

value.description: What the command receives, and what defaults match.

label.description: What the form shows instead of the value.

features.description: Switch features back on that a broader file disabled.

disable.description: Features to turn off for this repo.

default_profile.description: Preselected value for the profile param on every maven: command.

goals.description: Extra goals, or extra ways to detect a built-in one (a wrapper around spring-boot-maven-plugin, a plugin inherited from a parent pom).

goal.description: What mvn runs, e.g. spring-boot:run, or several separated by spaces (clean install).

plugin.description: artifactId, declared in <build><plugins>, that makes the goal show up. Leave out to show the goal in every repo with a pom.xml. For a built-in goal this adds another way to detect it.

run.description: The goal starts an application: it asks for a module and never uses -am. A built-in goal keeps its own setting when this is left out.

profile_param.description: Name of a form field for the framework's own profile. Goes with profile_prop; not module, profile or also_make.

profile_prop.description: System property that field is passed as, mvn -D<profile_prop>=<value>.
